typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Timestamp as string,
		{DFW5 Sensors_2_13 RackTemp} as string,
		{DFW5 Sensors_2_14 RackTemp} as string,
		{DFW5 Sensors_3_22 RackTemp} as string,
		{DFW5 Sensors_2_14 Rack} as string,
		{DFW5 Sensors_2_13 Rack} as string,
		{DFW5 Sensors_3_22 Rack} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource1
FlatFileSource1 derive(Fname1 = $FileName) ~> DerivedColumn1
FlatFileSource1 aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount10
DerivedColumn1 sink(input(
		Fname as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Fname = Fname1),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount10 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCount1CACHESINK
